questions.question: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine honoured work on which technique, which uses light to control nerve cells?
questions.explanation: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel were honoured on 5 October 2026 for the discovery of a molecular switch for nerve cells.

questions.question: Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for contributions to which neutrino observatory?
questions.explanation: IceCube, built in the Antarctic ice, detected high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin. The prize was announced on 6 October 2026.

questions.question: Which two scientists won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for 'mirror image' (asymmetric) molecule work?
questions.explanation: The Chemistry prize was announced on 7 October 2026.

questions.question: Who won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.explanation: Anne Carson is a Canadian poet, essayist and classicist. The prize was announced on 8 October 2026.

questions.question: Navi Pillay, a former UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, won the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. Which country is she from?
questions.explanation: The Norwegian Nobel Committee announced the prize on 9 October 2026. Pillay is South African of Indian Tamil origin.

questions.question: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences, awarded to Robert Hall and Michael Woodford, recognised research on what?
choices: Stabilising the economy through booms and busts
questions.explanation: They were recognised for the microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation. Announced on 12 October 2026.

questions.question: Who won the 2026 Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix on 11 October?
questions.explanation: Verstappen won from pole, his first Singapore GP win, ahead of Charles Leclerc and Kimi Antonelli.

questions.question: Who leads the 2026 Formula 1 drivers' championship after the Singapore Grand Prix?
questions.explanation: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli led his teammate George Russell by 102 points after Singapore.

questions.question: Which film topped the US box office on the weekend of 9 to 11 October 2026 with about $27.8 million?
questions.explanation: Other Mommy opened at number one, ahead of Verity ($12.0M).
